NTLA.title: Intellia Therapeutics Presents Additional Positive Clinical and Patient-Reported Data for Lonvoguran Ziclumeran (lonvo-z) at ACAAI 2026
NTLA.summary: Intellia Therapeutics announced positive clinical data for lonvo-z, its one-time CRISPR gene editing treatment for hereditary angioedema (HAE), presented at ACAAI 2026. ECOR.title: Randomized Study of Non-Invasive Autonomic Neuromodulation for Long COVID Published Online in Neuromodulation
ECOR.summary: electroCore and Sonocea published results from a randomized controlled trial evaluating non-invasive neuromodulation technologies for Long COVID treatment. The study of 250 participants showed improvements in fatigue, cognition, sleep, and mental health symptoms across active intervention groups compared to monitoring-only controls, with depressive symptoms decreasing 31-34% and PTSD symptoms reducing 39% with combined therapy. However, the open-label design without sham control and reliance on patient-reported outcomes limit the findings, which are considered hypothesis-generating and warrant confirmation in larger, sham-controlled studies.
